biotools.summary: The Cattle Quantitative Trait Locus (QTL) Database (Cattle QTLdb) is a curated resource providing QTL and association data from published literature, facilitating analysis and comparison of genetic factors influencing cattle production traits. It currently contains data from over 1200 publications.
